Local voice capture uses SenseVoiceSmall, originally released by Alibaba / FunAudioLLM (QwenAudio).
Official model: https://huggingface.co/FunAudioLLM/SenseVoiceSmall
Original model license: FunASR Model Open Source License Agreement v1.1 (included).
Official commercial use clarification: https://github.com/QwenAudio/SenseVoice/issues/334

INT8 ONNX conversion: sherpa-onnx / csukuangfj, version 2024-07-17.
https://huggingface.co/csukuangfj/sherpa-onnx-sense-voice-zh-en-ja-ko-yue-2024-07-17
The model is redistributed unchanged; gzip compression does not alter the ONNX weights.
Tokenizer: tokens.txt from the same conversion, bundled as voice-tokens.txt.

Native inference and JavaScript adapter library: sherpa-onnx-node / sherpa-onnx-win-x64 1.13.8.
Copyright the sherpa-onnx contributors; Apache License 2.0 (included).
https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx

ONNX Runtime: Copyright Microsoft Corporation; MIT license (included).
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime

No application code from VocoType is incorporated.
